item.title: 10 AI predictions for 2026
item.description: Generative AI continued its breakneck pace of adoption and technical progress last year. Now, after so much trialing and tinkering, 2026 is shaping up as the year AI starts to deliver on its promise, and reveal its limitations. According to Gartner, enterprises will spend a staggering $2.5 trillion on AI this year, up 44% from 2025. item.title: プロンプトエンジニアリング、最短で効く“型”とは？

item.title: 엔비디아 젠슨 황 “오픈AI 투자 철회설은 과장…사실 아니다”
